title: hk-ipo-analysis payload
description: The only contract from the source markdown to this payload. **The agent that read the source writes the whole object** (shot 1 `report` only drops the source text and the layer-1 truth on disk; shot 2 `render` reads and never parses prose). Each leaf has x-empty: ok means the source may omit it; warn means it should be present and payload_check will name it. Each leaf title says where in the source its value comes from. Source priority is in SKILL.md §2.1. Merge is payload_merge.merge_prefer. **Copy every numeric value verbatim from the source**: keep its decimals as written (the only conversion allowed is the unit named in that slot's `title`, e.g. values in 100 million), and leave the slot empty when the source does not give it — never compute, never substitute another slot, never pick a stray number out of the prose.

symbol.title: Hong Kong code: hk plus 5 digits (from the command line / MCP truth)

stock_name.title: Short name. Prefer MCP truth; fall back to the issuer name in the source's title line.

apply_start_date.title: Offer start, YYYY-MM-DD. Take the paired dates in the source's 招股期 sentence (招股期自2026年9月28日起至10月6日止); the year comes from the report's as-of sentence. Leave it empty when the source is silent (layer 4 fills it).

apply_end_date.title: Offer end, YYYY-MM-DD. Same 招股期 sentence; roll into the next year across New Year. Empty when the source is silent.

offer_price_min.title: Offer price low, digits only, no currency. Only when the source states a low end or a range (按1.48-1.59港元计); a single price or a high-end-only offer leaves this empty — never grab a stray number out of the prose.

offer_price_max.title: Offer price high, digits only, no currency. Take the high end the source states (按上限1.59港元) or the top of its range; repeat the low when there is one price.

applyAmountMin.title: One-lot entry fee in HKD, integer text. The digits in the source's 入场费约 3,180 港元.

trade_date.title: Listing day, YYYY-MM-DD. The source's 上市日 (or 预计上市日). Empty when the source is silent (layer 4 fills it).

currency.title: Currency, HKD or USD. Prefer MCP truth; otherwise read 港元 / 美元 in the source.

industry.title: Sector name. Copy module 8 of the filing. Do not reclassify it.

valuation.title: Valuation basis, copied from the filing. Empty if the filing has none.

rating_value.title: Overall stars, 0-5, one decimal as text. The star count in the source's module-1 AI评级 line, or the N in Phase 3.5 综合评级 N/5.0.

highlight.title: One-line highlight. The text after the colon in the source's module-1 一句话亮点.

subscription_score.title: Subscription score, 0-5 as text. Copy the 雷达图占位符 line 认购倍数：N分 verbatim (2.3 stays 2.3). If the source has no such line, leave it empty — never rescale the /20 subtotal

sentiment_score.title: Sentiment score, 0-5 as text. Copy the 资金与情绪博弈：N分 line verbatim; empty if absent, never rescale

industry_score.title: Industry score, 0-5 as text. Copy the 行业赛道：N分 line verbatim; empty if absent, never rescale

fundamental_score.title: Fundamentals score, 0-5 as text. Copy the 公司基本面：N分 line verbatim; empty if absent, never rescale

valuation_score.title: Valuation-margin score, 0-5 as text. Copy the 估值与安全边际：N分 line verbatim; empty if absent, never rescale

interpretation.title: Core points, one paragraph each. The source's module-1 核心逻辑（分析）, one paragraph per item.

rate_over.title: Oversubscription multiple, digits as text. The 超额认购倍数 in the source's module-2 数据卡片, minus the 倍 (3.91).

interpretation.title: Commentary. The source's module-2 分析 text, one paragraph per item (split where the source splits).

growthValues.title: Oversubscription multiple at each point in the offer window. The turning points the source gives in module 2's 面积折线图占位符 (one point → one value).

growthDateTime.title: Timestamps aligned one-to-one with growthValues, copied from the same module-2 placeholder.

totalMarginFrozenFunds.title: The 累计孖展冻资总额 from the source's module-2 数据卡片, verbatim.

publicOfferFundraisingAmount.title: The 公开发售集资额 from the source's module-2 数据卡片, verbatim.

publicOfferOversubscriptionMultiple.title: The 超额认购倍数 from the source's module-2 数据卡片, verbatim.

interpretation.title: One paragraph per sponsor, from the source's module-3 analysis (one sponsor per paragraph). label is the full name; text is the comment, then the track record: (N deals in the last 2 years, first-day up probability X%, average first-day gain Y%).

yAxisLabel.title: Each sponsor's first-day up probability over 2 years, as a percent number. Take each line of the source's module-3 柱状图占位符.

sponsorName.title: Sponsor names, aligned with yAxisLabel. The company name on each line of the source's module-3 柱状图占位符.

sponsorGreenshoeScore.title: Greenshoe score. null when the source gives no score — do not invent one.

sponsorGreenshoeMaxScore.title: Full marks for that score. Present only when the score is present.

interpretation.title: Commentary. The source's module-4 分析 text.

lockupPeriod.title: Lock-up, copied from the filing, e.g. 6 months

allocationRatio.title: Cornerstone share of the global offer, percent number. The 认购占全球发售 in the source's module-4 数据卡片 (46.52).

cornerstoneCount.title: Number of cornerstone investors. The 基石家数 in the source's module-4 数据卡片.

investmentAmount.title: Cornerstone amount, copied from the filing

cornerstoneQualityScore.title: Cornerstone quality score. null when the source has no anchor (the block is then omitted).

cornerstoneQualityMaxScore.title: Full marks for cornerstone quality. Present only when the score is present.

interpretation.title: Commentary. When it does not apply, one sentence is enough — a Hong Kong-only deal has no cross-market anchor (source module 5).

isApplicable.title: true when there is a cross-listed comparable; false for a Hong Kong-only deal (source module 5 says 纯港股 / no A-share or US anchor). Every other premium slot is then empty or 0.

relatedStockCode.title: Related A-share or US code — from the source's module-5 A/H anchor; leave it empty when the deal is Hong Kong-only.

hShareFinalOfferPrice.title: Final H-share offer price — from the source's module-5 A/H anchor; leave it empty when the deal is Hong Kong-only.

hShareDiscountVsAShare.title: H versus A premium or discount, copied from the filing — from the source's module-5 A/H anchor; leave it empty when the deal is Hong Kong-only.

aSharePriceConvertedToHkd.title: A-share price in HKD — from the source's module-5 A/H anchor; leave it empty when the deal is Hong Kong-only.

aSharePriceLastTradingDayBeforeListing.title: A-share close on the session before listing — from the source's module-5 A/H anchor; leave it empty when the deal is Hong Kong-only.

aShareTtmPe.title: A-share or US TTM multiple, copied from the filing — from the source's module-5 A/H anchor; leave it empty when the deal is Hong Kong-only.

interpretation.title: Commentary. The source's module-6 分析 text.

valuationType.title: Basis, e.g. PE or PS. The 估值类型 in the source's module-6 数据卡片.

hkValuation.title: This offer's multiple. The H股本次发行估值倍数 in the source's module-6 数据卡片 (12.3).

industryAvg.title: Peer average multiple. The 行业可比公司平均估值倍数 in the source's module-6 数据卡片; 0 when peers do not apply.

totalMarketCap.title: H-share market cap at the offer, copied from the filing

aShareTtm.title: A-share or US TTM multiple; 0 when it does not apply (source module 6).

interpretation.title: Commentary. One item per analysis point in module 7. label is the filing's own heading.

chart_data.title: Chart: net profit, gross margin, revenue

cagr.title: Revenue CAGR from the filing, e.g. 40.4%

currency.title: Statement currency: CNY, USD, or HKD. The unit line of the source's module-7 finance table (人民币千元 → CNY).

growthYears.title: Revenue year labels, copied from the filing (e.g. 2023 or 2026 H1)

growthValues.title: Revenue, in 100 million. The 营收 row of the source's module-7 折线图占位符, converted to 100 million.

netProfitYears.title: Net-profit year labels, copied from the same module-7 净利 row.

netProfitValues.title: Net profit, in 100 million (keep the minus sign when negative), from the same 净利 row.

netProfitMarginYears.title: Net-margin year labels; empty when the source gives none (module-7 净利率 row if present).

netProfitMarginValues.title: Net margin, from the same module-7 净利率 row; empty when the source gives none.

grossProfitMarginYears.title: Gross-margin year labels, from the module-7 毛利率 row.

grossProfitMarginValues.title: Gross margin, percent number, from the same module-7 毛利率 row.

roeYears.title: ROE year labels. Empty if the filing has none. — from the source's module-7 statements; empty when the source gives none.

roeValues.title: ROE. Empty if the filing has none. — from the source's module-7 statements; empty when the source gives none.

roaYears.title: ROA year labels. Empty if the filing has none. — from the source's module-7 statements; empty when the source gives none.

roaValues.title: ROA. Empty if the filing has none. — from the source's module-7 statements; empty when the source gives none.

pbYears.title: PB year labels. Empty if the filing has none. — from the source's module-7 statements; empty when the source gives none.

pbValues.title: PB. Empty if the filing has none. — from the source's module-7 statements; empty when the source gives none.

hasGreenshoe.title: true when the offer carries a greenshoe. The source saying 无绿鞋 / 无稳价人 means false.

interpretation.title: Commentary. The source's module-8 分析 text.

sectorName.title: Sector name. The source's module-8 数据卡片首行, verbatim (do not classify it yourself).

interpretation.title: Commentary. The source's module-9 分析 text.

hkHSIAnalysis.title: Hang Seng last close, digits only. The 恒生指数最近收盘点位 in the source's module-9 折线图占位符 (the renderer already names the index).

hkHSTECHAnalysis.title: Hang Seng TECH last close, digits only. The same module-9 line; empty when the source gives none.

oneLotWinRate.title: The 一手中签率 from the source's 中签预测速览, verbatim (60.0%).

subscribeLots.title: The 预计中1手需申购 from the source's 中签预测速览, as an integer.

summaryRows.title: Band table: One lot, Group A tail, Group B head, and the rest — take the four bold rows of the source's 不同申购档位预估 table

groupKey.title: Slot key, one of the six: oneLot / groupA / groupATail / groupB / groupBHead / topHammer (the renderer colours the tag by it). Take the four bold rows of the source's 不同申购档位预估 table.

groupName.title: Slot name for those same four bold rows.

subscribeLots.title: The 申购手数 column of those same four bold rows.

expectedWinLots.title: The 预计中签手数 column of those same four bold rows.

detailRows.title: Lot-by-lot rows — the full 不同申购档位预估 table of the source, row by row

groupKey.title: Slot key, same six as summaryRows; decide row by row from the source's 不同申购档位预估 table.

groupName.title: Slot name, row by row from the same table.

subscribeLots.title: The 申购手数 column of the same table, row by row.

expectedWinLots.title: The 预计中签手数 column of the same table, row by row.

expectedWinRate.title: The 平均每手中签率 column of the same table, row by row.

predictedOneLotWinRate.title: The 至少中一手概率 column of the same table, row by row.

label.title: Lead-in. The filing's label before the colon. Empty if there is no label.

text.title: Body. The filing's text after the colon. Keep the filing's wording.
